name: PR Monitor
description: Fetch open Bitbucket PR review comments, triage them, deploy SWEs to fix the code, and post generated replies. Depends on integration.atlassian-suite for credentials.
author: aarbuckle

replyInstruction.label: Reply Instruction
replyInstruction.default: Write a 1-2 sentence professional PR reply confirming what was fixed and where. No double-dashes.
replyInstruction.description: Instruction used to generate PR replies after SWEs fix the underlying code.

coderabbitReplyPersona.label: CodeRabbit Reply Persona
coderabbitReplyPersona.description: Optional persona or voice instruction layered on top of the Reply Instruction when the parent comment author is CodeRabbit. Leave blank to use the Reply Instruction unchanged for CodeRabbit replies.

flagFalselyResolved.label: Flag Falsely-Resolved Comments
flagFalselyResolved.description: When on, the agent scans PR comments whose body claims the issue is resolved (e.g., 'resolved', 'fixed', 'done') but which Bitbucket still marks as unresolved, and surfaces them for review. It does not auto-resolve anything.
